component.name: aws2-ecs
component.title: AWS Elastic Container Service (ECS)
component.description: Create, describe, list and delete clusters of AWS Elastic Container Service (ECS).
component.label: cloud,management

configuration.description: The shared configuration of the component. Each endpoint starts from a copy of it and then applies its own options.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

operation.description: The operation that the producer performs. The CamelAwsECSOperation header replaces this option.

overrideEndpoint.description: Whether the ECS client sends its requests to the URI of the uriEndpointOverride option instead of the AWS endpoint of the region. It has no effect when uriEndpointOverride is not set.

pojoRequest.description: Whether the producer takes the request from the message body, as the AWS SDK request class of the operation, for example a ListClustersRequest for listClusters. A body of another type fails. If false, the producer builds the request from the headers.

region.description: The AWS region of the ECS client, as the lowercase region ID, for example eu-west-1 (the value of Region.EU_WEST_1.id()). If not set, the AWS SDK takes the region from its default region provider chain, such as the AWS_REGION environment variable.

uriEndpointOverride.description: The URI of the endpoint that the ECS client uses instead of the AWS endpoint of the region, for example http://localhost:4566 for LocalStack. It is used only when overrideEndpoint is true.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

ecsClient.label: advanced
ecsClient.description: To use a custom software.amazon.awssdk.services.ecs.EcsClient. When this option is set or autowired, the endpoint does not build a client from the credentials, proxy, region, overrideEndpoint, uriEndpointOverride and trustAllCertificates options, and it does not close the client when it stops.

healthCheckConsumerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckConsumerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all consumer based health checks from this component

healthCheckProducerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckProducerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all producer based health checks from this component. Notice: Camel has by default disabled all producer based health-checks. You can turn on producer checks globally by setting camel.health.producersEnabled=true.

proxyHost.label: proxy
proxyHost.description: The host name of the proxy through which the ECS client sends its requests. The proxy is used only when proxyPort is set too.

proxyPort.label: proxy
proxyPort.description: The port of the proxy through which the ECS client sends its requests. The proxy is used only when proxyHost is set too.

proxyProtocol.label: proxy
proxyProtocol.description: The protocol of the proxy through which the ECS client sends its requests. It is used only when proxyHost and proxyPort are set.

accessKey.label: security
accessKey.description: The access key ID of the AWS credentials, used together with secretKey. It is required unless ecsClient is set or useDefaultCredentialsProvider, useProfileCredentialsProvider or useSessionCredentials is true.

profileCredentialsName.label: security
profileCredentialsName.description: The name of the profile that useProfileCredentialsProvider loads. If not set, the AWS SDK uses its default profile: the one of the AWS_PROFILE environment variable, or else default.

secretKey.label: security
secretKey.description: The secret access key of the AWS credentials, used together with accessKey. It is required unless ecsClient is set or useDefaultCredentialsProvider, useProfileCredentialsProvider or useSessionCredentials is true.

sessionToken.label: security
sessionToken.description: The session token of temporary AWS credentials, for example from assuming an IAM role. It is used only when useSessionCredentials is true, together with accessKey and secretKey.

trustAllCertificates.label: security
trustAllCertificates.description: Whether the ECS client accepts any TLS certificate without validating it, for example the self-signed certificate of a test endpoint set with uriEndpointOverride. It applies to every request of the client, not only to an overridden endpoint.

useDefaultCredentialsProvider.label: security
useDefaultCredentialsProvider.description: Whether the ECS client loads its credentials with the default credentials provider chain of the AWS SDK: system properties, environment variables, the profile files, and the credentials of the container or the EC2 instance. It takes precedence over the other credentials options.

useProfileCredentialsProvider.label: security
useProfileCredentialsProvider.description: Whether the ECS client loads its credentials from a profile of the AWS config and credentials files, the one of profileCredentialsName. It is ignored when useDefaultCredentialsProvider is true.

useSessionCredentials.label: security
useSessionCredentials.description: Whether the ECS client uses the temporary credentials made of accessKey, secretKey and sessionToken, for example after assuming an IAM role. If sessionToken is not set, accessKey and secretKey are used without it. It is ignored when useDefaultCredentialsProvider or useProfileCredentialsProvider is true.

CamelAwsECSOperation.label: producer
CamelAwsECSOperation.description: The operation that the producer performs. It replaces the operation option.

CamelAwsECSMaxResults.label: producer
CamelAwsECSMaxResults.description: The maximum number of clusters that listClusters returns in one page, from 1 to 100. If not set, Amazon ECS returns up to 100.

CamelAwsECSClusterName.label: producer
CamelAwsECSClusterName.description: The short name or the full ARN of the cluster. createCluster takes the name of the new cluster and deleteCluster requires it. If not set, Amazon ECS uses the cluster named default for createCluster and describeCluster.

CamelAwsECSNextToken.label: producer
CamelAwsECSNextToken.description: The token of the next page of listClusters. The producer reads it to request that page, and sets it from the response, or to null on the last page.

CamelAwsECSIsTruncated.label: producer
CamelAwsECSIsTruncated.description: Whether more clusters follow the ones that listClusters returned, that is whether the response has a next token. The producer sets it.

CamelAwsECSClusterArn.label: producer
CamelAwsECSClusterArn.description: The ARN of the cluster that the operation created, described or deleted. The producer sets it.

producerIn.description: Not used: the operations take their input from headers, such as the name of the cluster in CamelAwsECSClusterName. With pojoRequest=true the request of the AWS SDK for the operation, such as a ListClustersRequest: another body fails

producerOut.description: The response of the AWS SDK for the operation, such as the ListClustersResponse of listClusters, with the token of the next page in a header. describeCluster of a cluster that does not exist does not fail: the response lists it in its failures
